# Freeway Church

> Freeway Church is an Assemblies of God church in Albion, Michigan. Everyone is welcome. The church was formerly known as Albion Assembly of God and Albion World Outreach.

## Sundays

- 9:30am: Preservice prayer
- 10:00am: Worship service
- Nursery (ages 0–5) runs during the whole service. Kidsway (K–5th grade) has its own class during the service.
- 5:30–7:00pm: Freeway Youth (6th–12th grade)

## Christmas 2026: Wonder

- Wonder is a five-week Christmas series, Sundays November 29 – December 27, 2026, at 10:00am.
- December 6: Family Sunday with Communion, followed by a potluck Christmas brunch around 11:30am.
- Christmas Eve service: Thursday, December 24, 2026, 5:00–6:00pm.

## Location and contact

- Address: 28900 B Dr N, Albion, MI 49224
- Phone: 517-798-0571
- Email: info@freeway.church
- Website: https://www.freeway.church

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.freeway.church/): Who Freeway Church is, what a Sunday looks like, and recent messages.
- [Plan a Visit](https://www.freeway.church/visit): What to expect on a first Sunday, where to go, and answers to common questions.
- [Kids & Youth](https://www.freeway.church/kids): Nursery (0–5), Kidsway (K–5th) and Freeway Youth (6th–12th), with safety policies and parent FAQs.
- [What We Believe](https://www.freeway.church/beliefs): A plain-English look at what Freeway teaches as part of the Assemblies of God.
- [Giving](https://www.freeway.church/giving): How to give and how the church stewards its budget and supports its global partners.
- [FreeWay Leadership Academy](https://www.freeway.church/academy): A Christ-centered leadership program for kids in 1st–6th grade, with a track for pre-K and Kindergarten. Wednesdays: dinner at 5:30pm, program 6:30–8:00pm.
- [Flight School](https://www.freeway.church/flight-school): A free discipleship self-assessment on being faithful, available, teachable and missional.
